Lookup function for RNGs via string identifier

Source: R/lookups.R
rng_lookup.Rd

Lookup function for RNGs via string identifier

Usage

rng_lookup(family)

Arguments

family

String identifier of the likelihood family to get an RNG for. Unknown identifiers raise an error.

Value

The RNG function.

Examples

rng_lookup("gamma")
#> function (n, mu = 1, a = 1) 
#> {
#>     if (isTRUE(a <= 0)) {
#>         stop("gamma is only defined for a > 0")
#>     }
#>     if (isTRUE(mu <= 0)) {
#>         stop("gamma is only defined for mu > 0")
#>     }
#>     return(rgamma(n = n, shape = a, rate = a/mu))
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x562b9870de10>
#> <environment: namespace:bayesfam>
do.call(rng_lookup("gaussian"), list(n = 100, mean = 0, sd = 1))
